title: Evidence
description: One artifact in the evidence store (spec §6 'Evidence store', Appendix A). Content-addressed; immutable within a task.

storagePath.description: Path within the workspace-local content-addressed evidence store, relative to the task's evidence root.

criterionIds.description: Every mandatory criterion must have >=1 linked evidence artifact before a task can report success (spec §15 'Evidence completeness' launch gate).

runIndex.description: Which replay run (of runs>=2, see replay.schema.json) produced this artifact.

metadata.description: Kind-specific payload, e.g. {"resolution": [1280,720]} for screenshot, {"nunitResultPath": "..."} for nunit_result.
